blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang is confident President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. will sign the proposed P7.2-trillion 2027 national budget before year-end, avoiding a repeat of last year’s delay. In a briefing on Monday, Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the 2027 national budget should be passed by Congress on schedule, acknowledging that the process took longer than expected last year. “It should be,” Castro told reporters when asked if the Palace was confident that Congress would approve the spending bill on time. She declined to provide a timeline for the passage of the 2027 budget, saying circumstances could still change. READ: Key […]...
